| Project | EII (%) |
| ------- | ------- |
| x1      | 20      |
| x2      | 30      |
| x3      | 40      |
| x4      | 50      |

| Project | Revenue (USD) |
| ------- | ------------ |
| x1      | 10000        |
| x2      | 20000        |
| x3      | 30000        |
| x4      | 40000        |
